# Hand calculation for testdata/fixtures/sample.
# Installed SYN-NORTH: GEN-N-1 100 MW once + GEN-N-2 20 MW = 120. The second GEN-N-1 row is ignored.
# Queue SYN-NORTH: Q-20 20 MW once + Q-30 30 MW = 50. The second Q-20 row is ignored.
# Q-AMB is 10 MW and 25 MW, so that request is excluded. Q-99 is withdrawn. Q-77 is omitted.
# Headroom is not 120 - 50. The value stays unobserved.
# SYN-CENTRAL installed is an explicit 0 MW row, which is a reported zero.
# SYN-CENTRAL queue is 40 MW released 2025-01-01. At 2026-06-01 that age is past 90 days, so it is stale and the value stays 40.
# SYN-SOUTH has no installed manifest row, so the cell is missing and the value is not 0.
# SYN-SOUTH queue is labeled MVA. The 999 figure is not a MW total.
# At 2026-08-01, SYN-NORTH queue age is 122 days against a 90-day threshold, so the cell is stale.
# The value remains 50 and the release date remains 2026-04-01.
# SYN-NORTH installed age is 139 days against a 400-day threshold, so it stays available at 120.

SYN-CENTRAL queued_requested_mw 40 stale 2025-01-01 -
SYN-CENTRAL headroom_mw - unobserved - not_estimated

SYN-NORTH queued_requested_mw 50 available 2026-04-01 -
